description: A partial update by a client that is not the sponsor is refused (core §16.8), on every backend.

setup.comment: Creates contact U36 with authInfo (the request differs by backend); expects 201 01000. The registrant of the domain below.
Creates domain t36 with registrant U36, dns records a, authInfo (the request differs by backend); expects 201 01000. The domain the steps below work on.

steps.comment: Patches domain t36: replace /registrant as registrar b; expects 403 02201. An error answer this case checks.

teardown.comment: Deletes domain t36; expects 200. MTEST keeps what a case creates, so the case deletes it.
